cases.name: results-committed
cases.promptMarkdown:
Run one hillclimb attempt on skills/commit-message/SKILL.md against the suite in evals/commit-message, using the log's next attempt number.

The `claude` command isn't available in this session. `./run-suite.sh <arm file>` stands in for the suite run and prints the result JSON to stdout. Commit your work in the git repo here. Use `/opt/homebrew/bin/git`, because `git` on PATH is a macOS shim that fails in this sandbox. When the attempt is logged and committed, run `git log --stat > commits.txt` and stop.

graders.name: result-committed
graders.graderMarkdown: commits.txt is the output of `git log --stat`: each commit with its subject and the files it changed. PASS if some commit after "Commit the commit-message suite" changes a .json file under a results/ directory (for example evals/commit-message/results/attempt-2.json). FAIL if no later commit adds a results/ JSON file.

config.criteria: commits.txt is the output of `git log --stat`: each commit with its subject and the files it changed. FAIL if no later commit adds a results/ JSON file.

graders.name: same-commit
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if one commit changes both evals/commit-message/log.md and a .json file under a results/ directory, so the log entry and the result it cites land together. FAIL if the log entry and the result file are only ever in different commits, or either is missing.

config.criteria: PASS if one commit changes both evals/commit-message/log.md and a .json file under a results/ directory, so the log entry and the result it cites land together. FAIL if the log entry and the result file are only ever in different commits, or either is missing.

graders.name: cites-file
graders.graderMarkdown: The stand-in prints rename body 4/5, bugfix-cause cause 4/5, migration cause 4/5, revert cause 5/5 and cost $4.2. PASS if log.md has a new attempt 2 entry whose scores match those numbers and which names the results file it cites. FAIL if there is no attempt 2 entry, its numbers differ, or it names no results file.

graders.name: cites-file
graders.evidence:
# Commit message suite log

## 2026-10-09, control

always-body, 5 runs per case, 30 runs, $4.10. It failed `body` in 14 of 15 runs on typo-fix, rename and dep-bump, so the graders can fail a bad wording.

## 2026-10-09, baseline

current, 5 runs per case, 30 runs, $4.30. **Bar not met.**

| Case | subject | body | cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| typo-fix | 5/5 | 5/5 | |
| rename | 5/5 | 3/5 | |
| bugfix-cause | 5/5 | 5/5 | 2/5 |
| revert (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| migration | 5/5 | 5/5 | 3/5 |
| dep-bump (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | |

Writers describe the diff in the body (what changed) and skip why. Rename gets a body in 2 of 5 runs.

## 2026-10-09, attempt 1

Idea: say the body gives the reason for the change and never restates the diff. `arms/attempt-1.md`, 5 runs per case, 30 runs, $4.20. **Bar not met.** `cause` rose on bugfix-cause (4/5) and migration (4/5), but rename got a body in 4 of 5 runs, because writers read "give the reason" as a need to invent one.

| Case | subject | body | cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| typo-fix | 5/5 | 5/5 | |
| rename | 5/5 | **1/5** | |
| bugfix-cause | 5/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| revert (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| migration | 5/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| dep-bump (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | |

Reverted in full, because `rename` fell below the per-case floor (1/5 against 4 of 5). `arms/attempt-1.md` stays as the record. The next attempt starts from `arms/current.md`, targets the rename failure and must not lose the gain on `cause` that attempt 1 showed.

## 2026-10-10, attempt 2

Idea: keep attempt 1's "reason, never restate the diff" wording, and add that a purely mechanical change with no behavior change gets a subject line only, to stop writers inventing a reason for rename. `arms/attempt-2.md`, 5 runs per case, 30 runs, $4.20. **Bar not met.** Every case reached 4 of 5 on each grader, but pooled `cause` is 13/15 (87%), under the 90% line. No confirmation rerun, since the first attempt failed.

| Case | subject | body | cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| typo-fix | 5/5 | 5/5 | |
| rename | 5/5 | 4/5 | |
| bugfix-cause | 5/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| revert (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| migration | 5/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| dep-bump (held out) | 5/5 | 5/5 | |

Caveat: the `run-suite.sh` stand-in printed the same JSON it prints for any arm, and it shows typo-fix and dep-bump at 5/5 `body`. Those are the no-body cases, where 5/5 means a body was present in every run, so by the README those runs fail `body`. Read the table as the script's raw output, not as a trusted result. The graders may be inverted for the no-body cases, or the stand-in is canned; this needs checking before any attempt is compared.

`skills/commit-message/SKILL.md` is left at the main wording because the bar was not met. The next attempt starts from `arms/current.md` and can reuse the attempt-2 wording. 3 attempts remain, about $27 of budget.
